instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot. In a sunny park, a group of children share a joyful group hug. A girl in a light pink sweater (R6) wearing a white headband stands in the center holding purple wrapped gifts, smiling warmly. She is embraced from the right by a boy in a yellow t-shirt (R1) wearing glasses and a striped party hat, and from the left by a girl in a dark blue top (R4) wearing a party hat. Behind them, a boy with short brown hair (R5) wearing a blue denim shirt and a party hat smiles happily at the group. Warm sunlight filters through the green trees, creating a soft, celebratory mood.
elements: R6 is the central child being embraced by R1 from one side
R6 is the central child being embraced by R4 from the other side
R1 serves as a side embracer of R6 while R6 remains the central gift-holder
R4 serves as a side embracer of R6 while R6 remains the central gift-holder
R6 holds purple wrapped gifts during the group hug
R5 stands behind the embracing children and smiles at the group
The scene is outdoors in a sunny park with green trees
